fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-09-18 at about 15:25, it was reported that Rs. 12,000 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved. Padmini Bai submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000447. Yuvaraj Selvam (9000000434) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100017. Jeeva Rajan (9000000071), described as a friend of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Hariharan Babu may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000154.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, receiving account, suspect, mobile number, shopping complex, afternoon, witness
